rows.en: Touya: "All right, let's go!"
Aurelie: "So it came to this after all.
Looks like we have no choice but to fight that prince."
Celica: "Cain... The Cain I used to know is gone now..."
Fain: "All right! Princess, let us go
and put an end to future trouble!"
Celica: "...Be careful. Cain's unit performs
even better than Major Rest's Zaxas!"
Fain: "Even a superior weapon cannot demonstrate
its true worth unless its user can master it!
There's nothing to fear! Dahahahaha!"
Kasumi: "Don't let your guard down, Fain."
Fain: "Heh... Don't worry! I'll protect you!"
Kasumi: "That wasn't what I meant..."
Touya: "H-hey, are you sure this is all right?"
Melissa: "There's no need to worry.
Ahti remembers me perfectly well.
And it seems excited, since it's been so long."
Touya: "I don't really get it, but you're sure it's all right?"
Melissa: "Yes. Let's hurry.
Everyone's fighting, aren't they?"
Clovis: "Touya, let's go!"
Touya: "R-right..."
Steinies: "Spirit Mechs... It's my lucky day.
I can test the new model and pay you back for last time...
Hehehehehe..."
Touya: "Hey, what's going on?"
Steinies: "...We meet again. I'm glad
we could see each other again so soon..."
Touya: "You!"
Steinies: "Hehehehehe...
Coincidence is a frightening thing...
Now, let me show you what this Bargion can do."
Touya: "Damn... What lousy timing..."
Yamato: "What do we do?!"
Defeat Steinies.
Go fight Cain.
Touya: "We'll deal with these guys first!"
Steinies: "Spirit Mechs are here...
Now I've got a fine excuse to execute Grad's woman and daughter..."
Touya: "What the hell are you talking about?"
Steinies: "I'll finish you off
and burn that village to the ground..."
Fain: "What?! Are you insane?!"
Steinies: "I'm always serious...
Well then, shall we get started...?"
Touya: "Like hell I'll let you!"
Ai: "Touya. I'm going to do things my way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time I'll be acting
on my own."
Clovis: "I'll act alone. You handle things on your end."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I'm not ready to put my life in your hands.
I'll do things my way."
Xiujian: "...I don't intend to follow your orders.
I'll act on my own."
Celica: "I'm sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
Fain: "The burning soul of justice does not yet
dwell within you! I cannot obey someone like that!
And so I shall follow my own justice! That is all!"
Gen: "I'll show you how much I've grown!
So I'll be acting on my own. See you!"
Melvi: "Touya, I've got an idea.
So I'm going to act on my own."
Melissa: "I'll be acting on my own this time."
Kururu: "I'm going to fight my own way."
Leone: "I'm not sure I can follow your orders properly,
Touya. So I'll do things my own way this time."
Fain: "All right! Leave this to us!
Don't worry. With me here, there's no way
we'll lose to a bastard like that!"
Aurelie: "Don't get careless.
That man isn't all talk."
Kasumi: "Touya! Good luck!"
Touya: "Don't push yourself either!"
Kasumi: "Okay. Be safe."
Celica: "We've only just rescued Tix...
I'll protect him!"
Touya: "Celica! I'm counting on you to support everyone!"
Celica: "Leave it to me. You be careful too, Touya!"
Clovis: "Go on."
Arthur: "We're counting on you."
Touya: "Everyone... I'm counting on you!"
Steinies: "Impossible... This Bargion...
Damn you..."
Ai: "Sorry! Cain got away."
Yamato: "What do we do, Touya?"
Touya: "We go after him!
I'm not letting him burn that village down!"

review_batches.context: Read all 88 rows plus s_030/s_033/s_038/s_039. Tix-rescue aftermath, Cain/Steinies target choice, Melissa's Ahti reunion, conditional independent-action responses and division of forces.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve selectable targets, threats to Grad's wife/daughter and village, superior performance without guaranteeing victory, Kasumi's failed caution and every repeated trust branch. The male-coded foe at the final pursuit is inferred from Steinies's explicit village-burning threat; Ai's immediately preceding Cain-escaped report makes the antecedent potentially confusing. Keep it flagged for route/meaning review rather than substituting a new name.
